data.one_liner: Generate fake data models and JSON fixtures easily in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FixtureFactory API to define how to create model instances using Faker. It can produce single objects, lists, and corresponding JSON representations, with optional custom Faker instances.
use_when: Need quick mock data for unit or integration tests
Need JSON fixtures for API mocking or prototyping
avoid_when: Require large‑scale or relational data generation
Prefer compile‑time code generation of models
strengths: Works in pure Dart (no Flutter dependency)
Supports custom Faker instances and JSON output
